name: Yellowstone National Park
about: Summer (Jun–Aug) opens all roads and facilities, spring brings newborn wildlife and fall the elk rut, winter access is limited to guided snow tours.
overview: Geysers, hot springs, and the original national park, spread across a volcanic plateau larger than some small countries.
costOverview: There's no competing option once you're inside the gate — in-park dining runs well above what a normal small town would charge.

specialSeasons.text: Newborn bison, elk and bear cubs are common sights this time of year.
The elk rut is in full swing, with bulls bugling to attract mates.
